timing: Rules fixed after public report/documentation inspection, before parsing external allele records or FASTQ. Retrospective convenience collection; not blinded, preregistered publicly or prospective biology.
eligibility: All three documented examples retained regardless of outcome. A full allele table with aligned read/reference, source reference name, source Read_Status and positive integer multiplicity is eligible for assignment-row audit. FASTQ identity claims require exact sequence/RC linkage and sufficient inventory; failure downgrades scope and never excludes the case silently.
unit: External aligned-table row and its reported read-assignment weight, not assumed unique raw molecule. Any ambiguous reference assignment is reported separately; no inflation of biological replication.
exact_declared_template: Ungapped observed aligned read string equals the complete documented amplicon assigned by Reference_Name. Does not assert biological allele correctness.
any_alignment_indel: A gap in either aligned read or aligned reference within the supplied alignment, with alignment lengths equal. Annotation of this external alignment; not proof of repair mechanism.
normalization: Uppercase DNA; preserve N in strings; remove only '-' when defining observed_sequence. No translation or inference of coding frame. Gap pattern remains in full_alignment.
factorization: Target constant within every observed representation fiber; return actual table SHA256, ZIP member, one-based data row and its original values for heterogeneous-fiber witnesses. Never expand weighted rows into fictional read identifiers.
joint_partition: Compile source_status, exact_declared_template and any_alignment_indel jointly. Number of observed signatures is the coarsest sufficient partition for exactly these targets on this catalogue. No CFTR implication imposed.
raw_checks: Validate FASTQ structure, qualities, total counts and header uniqueness; paired NHEJ header match. Attempt strict equality and reverse-complement inventory linkage for single-end examples; NHEJ paired-to-merged correspondence remains unauthenticated without merger/replay. Document deficits, multiple assignments and failure of raw denominators.
comparator: Published CRISPResso2 table/report, no claim of fresh engine rerun or independent molecular truth. Reconcile table weights and source mapping/quantification statistics only when matching available units. Parameter cards must expose documentation-vs-report configuration differences including base-editor QW 10 vs20.
primary_decisions: Can source_status_and_reference export observed_sequence without information loss?
Can observed_sequence export source_status or does alignment/reference information remain necessary?
Which distinctions are retained by the joint three-target export?
Can table assignments be promoted to raw-denominator event rates under authenticated linkage?
independent_verification: Second implementation using sorted relational grouping, no calls into main factorization code; reparse external tables and verify all fibers, joint classes, exact counts and each returned counterexample locator.
not_applicable: No treated-control contrast or whole-family withdrawal fabricated for these tutorial examples.
success: All eligible cases audited and independently checked, raw/assignment scopes explicit, no misleading lifts. Positive and negative results retained. This is computational external-source transport only; no claimed new mathematical theorem, biological accuracy or representative generalization.
stop_and_repair: A parsing or conservation failure is an adapter failure; retain logs, issue versioned correction, rerun all affected cases. Never drop discordant rows to obtain success.
future_frontier: Accession-linked second experimental genealogy and orthogonal truth remain separate; candidate PRJNA1047080 (s41467-024-55104-1) to undergo prior-exposure and provenance audit before a new external benchmark. No molecular or publication claims from this step.
